dog.description_text:
Felicity is the sweetest dog I've ever met (I've been calling her Nellie). She loves people, cuddling, and affection (getting lots of pets and attention). She is a bit nervous/timid and easily overwhelmed by big city noises and chaos. She needs owners who live in a quieter area with space to run around, or people who are willing to be patient with her anxiety in the city. She is great with kids, dogs, and all people. She loves to play, run around, and wrestle with other dogs. I don't know how she is with cats as I've never seen her interact with one. She is calm, but loves to run and play outside (she is an athletic, young dog, so she needs a good amount of play and exercise). Her energy level is typically chill (2/3) when she's inside, but can increase to a 7 when she's running around outside. She does not bark or whine. I am teaching her commands and leash manners (she is a fast learner, incredibly smart). She has a high appetite and loves her farmer's dog. She also loves sweet potato, boiled chicken, and frozen carrots. She is house trained and sheds a typical amount. She is sweet, loving, and loyal. She knows how to sit, lie down, stay (getting better with that), and walk with a front harness (also improving though she needs work).
